notes: Measured on the GTA 6 marathon VODs (v2932194507 at 10:00:00, v2933767012 at 3:00:00); same layout in both. Facecam is top-left. IRL footage (found by the frame check) uses the full-frame layout with the irl box instead; its middle crop also misses the overlay. Re-measure if he changes overlay.
